about_the_game:
CosmicBreak Universal is now offering a delightful item pack especially for Kisrill's fans!

A must-have for all Kisrill's enthusiasts, this DLC includes limited characters like Kisrill and Kisrill-chan, parts, titles, and other exclusive items! Don't pass this chance up!

Pack Contents (Robot)
  • Kisrill
  • Kisrill-chan

Pack Contents (Parts)
  • Kisrill Rucksack BS（x1）
  • Kisrill Print Fan（x1）
  • Title [Kisrill Fan♪]（x1）

Pack Contents (Other)
  • 100 Rt
  • SP Garapon Ticket（x5）
  • Cosmo Harmonics 20%（x30）
  • Tune-Up Set 10（x5）
  • ALL×3 Ticket 1h（x3）

※Purchase of this Pack is limited to one per account.
※[SP Garapon Tickets] allow players to roll the Garapon in the Shop.
※The Zero Saber visible in the screenshot is not included in this Pack.
